pr_title: sql: fix `SHOW COMPLETIONS` length check panic
pr_body:
fixes #84153

In cases where the offset was larger than the rune length of statements with special 
characters, `SHOW COMPLETIONS` would return a panic. We now apply the offset on a byte slice before casting to a rune to fix that issue.

Release justification: Bug fix for SHOW COMPLETIONS

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/87530)

>Before the fix, this test would pass with an offset of 30. It failed after the offset was changed 25

erm, I'm not following, if 25 is out of range wouldn't 30 also be out of range?

> if 25 is out of range wouldn't 30 also be out of range?

it would, but i'm guessing 30 did not panic because it would short-circuit at the `len(stmt)` check.

Thanks for all the reviews!

bors r+
